description: Detects one source IP failing logins against many distinct user accounts in a short window - the low-and-slow pattern of trying one common password against everyone.

detection.logic_plain_english: Count failed login events grouped by source IP. Alert when a single IP has failures against 4 or more DISTINCT users within any rolling 30-minute window.

false_positive_notes: Shared NAT/proxy egress and misconfigured service accounts can look like spraying. Whitelist verified corporate egress IPs and investigate whether the targeted usernames follow a pattern (e.g. alphabetical) before blocking the source.
name: Password spraying from a single source
